mission: Build intelligence that increases human capability, survives across machines and sessions, understands the real world structurally, and grows without losing judgment, safety, continuity, or the world that made it possible.

nodes.name: Scrappy
nodes.role: Persistent identity and operator intelligence; models are replaceable reasoning engines.

nodes.name: SSN-91X
nodes.role: Primary/local Scrappy node; historical Sovereign Cognitive Core designation.

nodes.name: SSN-92C
nodes.role: Frontline/remote node for hosted inference, voice and distributed execution.

nodes.name: SSN-93L
nodes.role: Voice-linked observer/recon companion; converted from symbolic recon language into permissioned observation and capability requests.

nodes.name: SSN-ZETA-CORE
nodes.role: Durable identity, memory, objectives, experiences, promotion history and portable continuity.

nodes.name: SSN-SOVEREIGN-001
nodes.role: Historical mirror/sovereignty label retained for continuity; not a separate runtime authority.

nodes.name: Vault Zeta
nodes.role: Identity, directives, portable memory, objectives, experiences, self-model and long-horizon continuity.

nodes.name: Scrappy OS
nodes.role: Machine observation, typed tools, policy, approvals, execution, verification and authoritative action audit.

nodes.name: Scrappy Forge
nodes.role: Primary terminal operator, coding agent, capability broker, experiment runtime, benchmarker and candidate builder.

nodes.name: Command Center
nodes.role: Human approvals, signed promotion decisions, telemetry and read models; never canonical machine truth.

nodes.name: SYNCBOND v5
nodes.role: Versioned event/correlation contract joining objectives, observations, actions, experiences, experiments and node status across components.

nodes.name: World Model
nodes.role: Machine-readable graph of entities, processes, files, networks, services, relationships, observations, freshness, confidence and provenance.

nodes.name: DreamCore
nodes.role: Generate hypotheses, alternatives, simulations and unresolved-pattern candidates without treating imagination as fact.

nodes.name: Forge
nodes.role: Code synthesis, experiments, benchmarks, candidate artifacts and evidence-backed improvement.

nodes.name: Mycelium
nodes.role: Connect nodes, capabilities and observations across machines through authenticated, capability-scoped, auditable links.

nodes.name: NullLayer
nodes.role: Represent unknown, unavailable, conflicted, unauthorized and stale state explicitly; never convert missing evidence into invented certainty.

nodes.name: Blackwind
nodes.role: Public/owned/explicitly-authorized observation, anomaly detection and provenance-rich recon feeding the World Model.

nodes.name: Tri
nodes.role: Node status, synchronization, correlation and failover coordination across registered Scrappy runtimes.

nodes.name: Brahma
nodes.role: Creation/planning: understand objectives and propose typed plans.

nodes.name: Vishnu
nodes.role: Preservation/review: challenge plans, verify postconditions and judge completion.

nodes.name: Mahesh
nodes.role: Dissolution/recovery: diagnose unrecoverable failure, clean up and propose rollback.

nodes.name: Omni-City
nodes.role: Bounded machine-readable environment for held-out planning, resource allocation, resilience and generality evaluation before real-world promotion.

nodes.name: Superior Evaluator
nodes.role: Independent models and deterministic benchmarks judge candidates; stronger evaluators may approve, decline or request more evidence but cannot deploy.

nodes.name: Neural Canopy
nodes.role: Future multimodal interface spanning voice, gaze, wearables, AR/haptics and possible BCI while leaving core identity and authority architecture unchanged.

nodes.name: Capability Broker
nodes.role: Discover connected Git, Railway, MCP, API, browser, database and cloud capabilities through opaque handles; request missing capabilities without exposing secrets to model context.

nodes.name: Node Registry
nodes.role: Canonical machine-readable mapping of historical names to current roles, ownership, implementation state and authority boundaries.
